summary: Backend-only testing for Personal AI Stock Market Copilot. Created /app/backend/tests/test_stock_copilot.py (19 pytest tests covering health, dashboard US/both, quote valid/invalid 404, /stock/{sym}/analyze AI schema, news, scanner, briefing, search, watchlist CRUD, portfolio CRUD + AI analysis, and recommendation-change alert flow). Initial run: 17/19 passing. Found 1 backend bug — /api/dashboard returned HTTP 500 on cache hit due to naive vs. tz-aware datetime subtraction in _cache_get (Motor returns naive UTC datetimes). Applied a minimal fix to /app/backend/server.py to normalize the stored ts to tz-aware before comparing. After fix: 19/19 passing in 10.84s (most AI endpoints served from cache after initial population). All AI-generated responses (analyze, news summary, briefing, portfolio analysis) returned the full documented JSON schema with valid recommendation/confidence/lists/strings. Recommendation-change alert flow verified end-to-end (force-mutated cached rec via MongoDB then re-ran analyze → alert appeared in /api/alerts). yfinance occasionally 404s on TATAMOTORS.NS; server handles gracefully and bulk endpoints still succeed.

minor.issue: [FIXED by tester] _cache_get subtracted naive datetime (from Mongo) from tz-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc) → 500 on every cache hit. Normalized ts to tz-aware in server.py.

action_items: Review the tz-aware datetime fix in server.py::_cache_get (lines ~74-85). Consider applying similar normalization to any other place that reads timestamps from Mongo to avoid recurrence (currently the only consumer).
Optional: cap dashboard/scanner concurrency or add per-symbol timeouts — yfinance bulk fetch can be slow on first call (~30-60s) before cache warms.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~470 lines — acceptable for now but watchlist/portfolio/alerts/search could each be split into routers for clarity if it grows.
ai_engine._extract_json uses greedy regex — works for current prompts but a nested JSON with unbalanced braces in LLM output could fail silently and return {}. Current callers degrade gracefully.
market_data.fetch_quote relies on yfinance .info which is known to be slow/throttled. Consider yf.download fallback for price-only paths.
No rate limiting / auth — acceptable per spec (single-user private app).
seed_data_creation: Tests insert and clean up watchlist MSFT and portfolio AAPL/MSFT. teardown_class deletes portfolio holdings. Alert-flow test temporarily writes to db.recommendations[NVDA] (overwritten on next real analyze).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All endpoints verified live against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. AI endpoints depend on cache after first run — to re-test cold, clear db.cache before pytest. Recommendation-change test uses pymongo directly to mutate db.recommendations and clear analyze cache; if AI happens to return the same rec as the forced one, the test pytest.skips (cannot validate). yfinance can intermittently 404 on TATAMOTORS.NS which is handled by server.
rca_of_issue: Bug: GET /api/dashboard returned 500 on second call. RCA: db.cache stores datetime via motor; pymongo by default decodes BSON UTC datetimes as naive Python datetimes. _cache_get computed (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - row['ts']) → TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Mitigation: in _cache_get, if ts.tzinfo is None, set ts = ts.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc). Verified by re-running dashboard tests post-fix → 200 OK.
